class.name: WorldWeather
class.brief_description: The weather contract: what the air, the sky and the surface water are doing at a point.
class.description: Every world system that reads the weather reads it through this contract ([method WorldContracts.get_weather]), never through the producer. The producer is the active [WeatherMap3D]; with none, each query returns its documented default. A test replaces it with a script extending this class and overriding the virtuals it needs (the rest fall back to the producer or the default), set with [method WorldContracts.set_weather]. See docs/ideas/world-contracts.md.

method.name: add_contact_wetness
method.description: Wets surfaces round [param position] (a splash, a spill, the sea's swash).

method.name: air_humidity_at
method.description: The relative humidity (0..1) of the air at [param position]. Default 0.7.

method.name: air_temperature_at
method.description: The air temperature (C) at [param position]: the live air through the season and the day's cycle. Default 15.

method.name: canopy_closure_at
method.description: The share of the sky closed by the canopy overhead (0..1). Default 0.

method.name: canopy_drip_at
method.description: Water dripping from the leaves (mm/h). Default 0.

method.name: canopy_water_at
method.description: Water held on leaves (mm). Default 0.

method.name: canopy_wetness_at
method.description: How wet the leaves are (0..1). Default 0.

method.name: cloud_base_at
method.description: The low cloud's base (m above y = 0) over the point: the condensation level of the day's air (WeatherMap3D.get_cloud_base_now), lower round storms with their own bases. Default 1500. Readers: mist and fog, lightning's strike height, the snow line and orographic rain.

method.name: cloud_cover_at
method.description: Cloud cover over the point, 0 to 1. Default 0.

method.name: contact_wetness_at
method.description: Water other systems splashed onto surfaces at [param position] (0..1). Default 0.

method.name: day_of_year
method.description: The day of the year, 1 to 365: the clock's date, else the weather's season day. Default 135 (15 May).

method.name: dew_point_at
method.description: The dew point (C) of the air at [param position], from the two above.

method.name: dust_at
method.description: Mineral dust in the column over [param position], g/m² (dust storms, haboobs).

method.name: dust_concentration_at
method.description: Mineral dust at [param position], g/m³.

method.name: dust_top_at
method.description: The dust layer's top over [param position], metres above the ground (a haboob's nose included).

method.name: fog_drip_at
method.description: Fog water the vegetation combs out of the passing cloud and drips onto the ground at [param position], mm/h: about 0.03 to 0.1 under a closed forest in a moderate wind once its leaves are full, a tenth of that over open ground. Already part of [method ground_water_input_at]. Default 0.

method.name: fog_water_at
method.description: Cloud water at the ground at [param position], g/m3: where the terrain stands in the cloud (hill fog), about 0.1 to 0.5. Default 0.

method.name: frost_at
method.description: Hoarfrost on exposed surfaces (mm of water). Default 0.

method.name: ground_height_at
method.description: The terrain height the weather sees under the point, in meters (its wind terrain, else its ground height). Default 0.

method.name: ground_water_input_at
method.description: Water reaching the ground under the canopy (mm/h). Default 0.

method.name: has_provider
method.description: Whether a producer (a [WeatherMap3D] in the tree) stands behind this contract.

method.name: high_cloud_cover_at
method.description: High (cirrus) cloud cover over the point, 0 to 1. Default 0. Separate from [method cloud_cover_at].

method.name: mean_wind_at
method.description: The mean wind at 10 m over [param position] in m/s (y 0), with the terrain's speed-up and turning but no gusts. Zero with no weather.

method.name: cloud_effector_at
method.description: The cloud density effectors at the point, -1 to 1: the share of cloud they add (above 0, a plume feeding a cloud) or clear (below 0, a blast's hole). Default 0. Separate from [method cloud_cover_at]: effectors change the clouds' density, not the cover the rain reads.

method.name: mountain_wave_at
method.description: The air's vertical displacement (m) in mountain waves at the point: positive where the waves lift it. Default 0. From linear theory over the terrain (WeatherMap3D, wave clouds): no rotors or lee turbulence.

method.name: mountain_wave_velocity_at
method.description: The mountain waves' vertical wind (m/s) at the point, the wind times the displacement's slope along it. Default 0. [method WeatherMap3D.get_wind_at] already adds it above the boundary layer; read this for the waves alone (gliders, birds, smoke aloft).

method.name: mid_cloud_cover_at
method.description: Mid (altocumulus) cloud cover over the point, 0 to 1. Default 0. Separate from [method cloud_cover_at].

method.name: obstacle_height_at
method.description: How high wind-blocking obstacles (rocks, walls, buildings, vehicles) stand over the ground at [param position], m, on the provider's shelter grid. Snow drift counts them as terrain in Winstral's Sx. Default 0.

method.name: obstacle_lee_at
method.description: The near-ground wind at [param position] behind upwind obstacles over the open wind: about 0.15 in the cavity to 2 heights downwind, recovering over 6 heights, 1 past 25 heights or in the open. [param position]'s height over the ground counts as a surface raised in the lee (a snow drift): the lee fades out as it reaches 1.2 times the obstacle's height, a drift at equilibrium (Tabler 1991); pass the ground's height for the bare ground. Blowing snow and sand slow and drop there. Default 1.

method.name: orographic_factor_at
method.description: The orographic factor [method precipitation_at] already carries at [param position] (the terrain climate's precipitation pattern, applied by [WeatherMap3D] [member WeatherMap3D.orographic_rain]); 1 where none is applied. A reader with its own climate read divides this out.

method.name: precipitation_at
method.description: Water falling at [param position] (mm/h, rain and snow as water). Default 0.

method.name: puddle_at
method.description: Standing water at [param position] (mm). Default 0.

method.name: rain_share_at
method.description: The liquid share (0..1) of what falls at [param position]. Default 1.

method.name: rainfall_at
method.description: Rain at [param position] (mm/h of liquid). Default 0.

method.name: rime_at
method.description: Rime on exposed twigs and edges at [param position]: the length is the deposit in mm, the direction horizontal and into the wind it grew from (the feathers point that way). Supercooled cloud freezing on contact (Makkonen 2000); zero with no producer.

method.name: salt_at
method.description: Sea salt left on surfaces at [param position], in g/m2: sea spray and fine salt aerosol settled from breaking waves upwind, washed off by rain. 0 by default. Plants read it for salt burn.

method.name: sea_spray_at
method.description: Sea spray settling at [param position], in mm/h of sea water: drops torn from breaking waves ([method WorldWater.breaking_at]) carried inland by the wind, within tens of metres of the surf. 0 by default. It wets surfaces and the ground ([method surface_wetness_at], [method ground_water_input_at]).

method.name: season_at
method.description: The season's state at the point's height on a day of the year (below 1: today), with the live departure from the climate: phenology, snowpack, soil frost (the keys of WeatherMap3D.get_season), and for today the place's latest late frost ([code]leaf_frost[/code], [code]leaf_frost_forcing[/code], [code]leaf_frost_days[/code]; WeatherMap3D.late_frost). Default: the default climate.

method.name: smoke_at
method.description: Fires' smoke in the air over [param position], g/m2 of particulate in the column (the weather's smoke haze layer, about 2 km deep). Default 0.

method.name: smoke_concentration_at
method.description: Smoke particulate at [param position] (g/m3): the column ([method smoke_at]) over its mixing depth, the 2 km day layer, or a night's cold pool where it holds the smoke let out under it near the ground. A stub that overrides only [method smoke_at] gets the 2 km mix.

method.name: snowfall_at
method.description: Snow at [param position] (mm/h of water). Default 0.

method.name: sun_visibility_at
method.description: The share of the sun's disc clear of cloud at [param position] (0..1). Default 1.

method.name: surface_temperature_at
method.description: Exposed ground's temperature in degrees Celsius: below the air under a clear calm night sky. Default: the air's.

method.name: surface_wetness_at
method.description: How wet open surfaces are at [param position] (0..1: the water film over its storage; 1 where puddles stand). Default 0.

method.name: terrain_lee_at
method.description: How deep [param position] lies in the lee of upwind ground, in radians: Winstral's Sx, the steepest rise of the ground upwind within the terrain wind's reach (positive in a ridge's lee, negative where the ground is exposed). The wind separates from the ground behind a crest when it passes about 0.3 (17 degrees). [code]NAN[/code] where no terrain wind covers the point or with no weather.

method.name: time_scale
method.description: The weather's time per real second. Default 1.

method.name: valley_fog_top_at
method.description: Height (m) of the top of the valley fog over [param position]: a radiation fog filling a cold air pool to the level where its air is saturated, flat across the basin. [code]-INF[/code] where there is none or with no producer.

method.name: washout_at
method.description: How fast the rain and snow falling here wash particles out of the air, 1/s: [method washout_rate] of [method rainfall_at] and [method snowfall_at].

method.name: washout_rate
method.description: Below-cloud scavenging coefficient, 1/s, as [code]a R^b[/code] with [code]R[/code] in mm/h of water. Fine smoke (PM2.5): about 1e-5 at 1 mm/h of rain (Laakso et al. 2003). [param coarse] dust over 10 um: about 3e-4 (Wang et al. 2010). Snow washes about five times as much as rain for the same water (Kyro et al. 2009).

method.name: water_temperature
method.description: Open water's temperature in degrees Celsius, lagging the air by about a month. Default 15.

method.name: wind_aloft_at
method.description: The free wind over the terrain at [param altitude] (m) in m/s (y 0), for clouds and smoke columns. Zero with no weather.

method.name: wind_at
method.description: The wind (m/s) at [param position], [param height_above_ground] metres up (below zero: 10 m), sheltered by canopy and obstacles. Default still.

method.name: _wave_cloud_density_at
method.description: Override in a stub: [method wave_cloud_density_at].

method.name: wave_cloud_density_at
method.description: Wave cloud (lenticular) extinction (1/m) at the point: moist air lifted past saturation by mountain waves. Default 0. Separate from [method cloud_cover_at]; it shades the ground only through its own optical depth in the cloud shadow.
